_about: Methanol (1) + Water (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: X. Yang, H. Li, C. Cao, Z. Zou, L. Xu, G. Liu, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium for the Binary System of Dimethyl Adipate and 1,6-Hexanediol at 10, 20, and 99 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 64 (2019) 4256-4263
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0050. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.06 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
